step.caption: Tap Scale (4,8), turn E3 two detents to change the scale from Major to natural minor and press K3, then tap Channel (3,8). Play the white keys: C D Eb F G Ab Bb C sound as 60 62 63 65 67 68 70 72. Black keys still repeat the white key above them: C# plays 62 and D# plays 63. Read the strip below for the thirteen keys C to C: 60 62 62 63 63 65 67 67 68 68 70 70 72, the eight white keys being 60 62 63 65 67 68 70 72.
step.title: Change the scale, change the keys
